name: op_image_swap_repaints
description: O1 CONTENT-OVERLAY INVARIANT (node-image arm): swapping ONE image node's content must repaint that image — as a PAINT-ONLY change (no DOM regeneration, bounded relayouts) with correctly-scoped damage. This is the class that shipped as 'camera/video/canvas updates invisible on CPU': the write path parked new content where the display-list diff never looked. mount creates the (NodeType::Image with a placeholder), set_node_image routes CallbackChange::ChangeNodeImage through LayoutWindow::apply_content_change (the ONE write chokepoint) — the display list re-resolves the node's image through ResolvedContent (overlay-first), so damage falls out of ImageRef identity. LIVENESS: assert_changed (damage non-empty AND pixels differ). SOUNDNESS: assert_damage_covers_changes. TIER: assert_work_bounded with max_dom_regens 0 — an image swap that regenerates the DOM is the old set_node_type mutation sneaking back.
